//: Mirrors maestro-ui/tsconfig.json at snapshot b422978 — the config the 270-file collab-v2 module was gate-verified against. Deliberately NOT stricter: adding noUnusedLocals/noUnusedParameters here produced 20+ errors inside Atlas's module that are config drift rather than transplant breakage, and satisfying them would have meant editing files this lane does not own.
//react-types-pin: @types/react-mentions declares a floating `@types/react: "*"`, which bun resolved to 19.x nested beside it while this app is React 18. That made MentionsInput/Mention typecheck as React-19 components and fail at their JSX use sites in Composer.tsx — the giveaway being 'bigint is not assignable to ReactNode', a React-19-only widening. It is types-only: esbuild strips types, so the runtime was never affected. The `paths` pin above fixes it WITHOUT editing Composer.tsx, which this lane does not own, and without another install cycle.
//react-types-pin-both-layouts: TWO candidates per key, and the second is the load-bearing one. A `paths` entry that resolves to nothing is silently ignored, and `./node_modules/@types/react` exists only under a per-package install. A workspace-wide `bun install --frozen-lockfile`, which is exactly what CI runs, HOISTS @types/react to the repo root and creates no packages/ui/node_modules/@types/react at all — so this pin resolved to nothing there and the four TS2786/TS2322 errors it was written to fix were red on every CI run while passing locally. Reproduced by rebuilding the hoisted layout and re-running `tsc -b packages/ui`: red before this line, clean after, and still clean in the per-package layout.
//tests: Tests are compiled and run by Vitest, not by tsc — same rationale as the source repo: test-only imports of node builtins (node:fs/path/url, used by the purity tests to walk the source tree) must not break the browser build, and app code stays guarded against accidental node imports because `types` omits @types/node.
